_doc: UI-test av inpassningen i The Character Creator (tools/studio/ui_test.py): sysslingens Pixal3D-form passas in genom kortet Fit an AI shape (reglagen och wrapen, några minuter), figuren visas i 3D med overlay-bilden. Skriver assets/characters/ui_test_fit/ och build/human/fit/ui_test_fit/; ta bort dem efteråt. Kör mot studio-test: url med port 8771.
name: creator_fit

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#huside select'); s.value = 'build/characters/syssling/syssling_pixal3d_00001_.glb'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const n = [...document.querySelectorAll('#huside input[type=text]')][0]; n.value = 'ui_test_fit'; return s.value; })()

steps.label: the AI shape list has the Pixal3D shapes
the fit runs as a job with a clock

steps.eval: ({ ok: __studio.human.lastFit?.ok, start: __studio.human.lastFit?.start, end: __studio.human.lastFit?.end, wrap: __studio.human.lastFit?.wrap?.end, ms: __studio.human.lastFit?.ms, stats: __studio.human.stats, msg: [...document.querySelectorAll('#huside .note')].map((n) => n.textContent).filter(Boolean) })

steps.label: the fit brings the template closer to the AI shape
the fitted recipe and its wrap are loaded into the sliders
the fit is listed as a saved figure
